blocked_reason: No hosted cloud CLI or IaC tool is installed in the current environment, and no hosted staging account/project, DNS zone, workload identity, state backend, or provider credentials have been bound.

required_services.container_registry: hosted registry with immutable digest deployment
required_services.kafka: managed Kafka or documented compatible broker
required_services.secret_manager: hosted secret manager with workload identity
required_services.dns_provider: dedicated staging DNS zone or delegated hostname

execution_prerequisites: one supported cloud CLI authenticated to a dedicated staging account
one IaC tool installed and configured
remote or protected IaC state backend
DNS control for a non-production staging hostname
cloud billing/quota read access or explicit documented blocker
